name: Animate Objects

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: nonmagical objects in range that nobody wears or carries and that aren't fixed or Gargantuan

upcast.text: Slam damage increases per slot level above 5 (1d4 for Medium or smaller, 1d6 for Large, 1d12 for Huge).

summary: Loose nonmagical objects in range become your fighters for up to a minute.
text: Animate objects up to your spellcasting modifier (Large counts as 2, Huge as 3); each uses the Animated Object stat block, acts on your turn and attacks with a Slam when you command it as a Bonus Action. Their Slam damage grows with higher slots.
